versions.changelog:
Initial release of idea-darwin-zh:

- Launches the Chinese version of the Idea Darwin engine, an automated structured idea iteration and evolution system.
- Supports importing ideas from ideas.md, structuring them into scored cards, and running multi-round iteration (deepening, branching, crossing, critique, validation).
- Provides a command interface for initialization, running iteration rounds, viewing statuses, and managing idea states (active/dormant).
- Features a comprehensive scoring system across six dimensions, with multi-layered evaluation formulas to surface high-potential ideas.
- Includes an automatic round-based workflow covering idea import, scoring, action allocation, cross-pollination, deduplication, and reporting with user decision prompts.
- Integrates external stimuli at configurable intervals to disrupt local optima and inject new perspectives into the idea pool.
